slides.head: Bought the share. Missed the dividend?
1. Qualification date
slides.body: You must be on the company's register by this date. Buy early enough for your trade to settle: ask your broker how long that takes.

slides.head: 2. Closure date
slides.body: The register closes so the company can work out who gets paid.

slides.head: 3. Payment date
slides.body: The money arrives. With an e-dividend mandate, it goes straight to your bank account.

slides.head: No free money.
slides.body: Share prices often drop by about the dividend once the share goes ex-dividend. Rules change, so check with your broker.

slides.head: Know the stock before you buy the story.
slides.body: Dividend season is coming. Get ready, free, at moloneystreetre.com
